name: prd-pipeline
description: One marketplace for the whole stack: the tier-adaptive prd-pipeline build path, the Compound V skill set, the Bad Research deep-research engine, and superdesign. Each plugin stands alone; install only what you want.

plugins.name: prd-pipeline
plugins.description: Build pipeline: idea -> the smallest spec that earns its keep -> adversarial grill -> confirmed plan-gate -> parallel git-worktree build -> verified ship. Tier-adaptive, so a trivial fix writes no document and a one-way door gets the full treatment. Routes every change against the docs that already exist (amend / supersede / create) instead of writing a new PRD by reflex, and budgets at most one new document per change. Standalone — needs no other plugin.

plugins.name: compound-v
plugins.description: The judgment around the code, as ~28 short skills behind one router: startup / product / distribution taste, brainstorming and plans, TDD, systematic debugging, verification before completion, read-only review, agent security (the lethal trifecta), evals, context engineering, and AI-system architecture. Pulled live from upstream, never vendored, so it cannot go stale here.

plugins.name: bad-research
plugins.description: Deep, multi-source, fully-cited research. Tier-adaptive: a bounded question gets a fast cited answer; a broad or contested one gets the full adversarially-reviewed report with every claim bound to a source. Prompt skills + 17 agents load instantly; the Python `bad` engine self-bootstraps on first use (needs Python 3.11-3.13 and uv or pipx).

plugins.name: superdesign
plugins.description: Design and build brand-specific UI with React + Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui through a system-first workflow: brand -> OKLCH tokens -> a vetted pattern cookbook -> polish -> anti-slop and accessibility gates. Use for any UI work, or whenever an interface looks generic and needs to look deliberately designed.
